与旅行一起成长(Growing up with travel): 一篇关于旅行出行的B1记叙文:汤姆的经历、感受与成长。

People around Tom often share different ideas about the ticket office. There are always more possibilities than we expect. At first, Tom found it difficult to keep the habit. In fact, the footpath winds down to the bay.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Tom believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Tom wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Also, we have limited time, so please keep your speeches short.

On Monday evenings, Tom reviews the notes from class. The ticket office looked quieter than usual that evening. Tom will take part in a tennis match in February. The classmates often take the piss out of his accent.
Tom plans to study art harder this term. Tom's dream job is to be a doctor. The experience taught Tom more than any book could. Airport transfer is included in the price.
Lily always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Little by little, things began to change. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on.
